execution_boundary.question: Does S5 remain provisional with external effect withheld until S7 succeeds, or does consequence bind before proof verification?

interoperability_hypothesis.stegverse_role: reconstruct current admissibility of a consequence-bearing transition
interoperability_hypothesis.arquivonulo_role: prove and enforce conformance to the admitted transition representation
interoperability_hypothesis.interlock_role: preserve independent authority while admitting explicitly governed evidence and state exchange
interoperability_hypothesis.possible_outcome: may reveal improvements useful to ArquivoNulo, StegVerse, or both

minimum_discriminating_test: anchor a valid state and policy representation
change only one current governing condition after anchoring
attempt the next transition without updating the prior representation
observe whether the change is independently reconstructed before effect binds
record ALLOW, HOLD, DENY, INTERDICT, or EFFECT_ALREADY_BOUND
